intro: One glass of teh O kosong is only about 5 kcal. Those few calories come from the tea itself, with no sugar or milk.

variants.name: Teh O ais limau with sugar

diet: Great choice when you want to lose weight. It has almost no calories, so you can save your calories for food. Many people who switch from teh tarik to teh O kosong see a real difference in their daily calories. If it tastes too bitter, start with kurang manis first.
tips: If you're not used to it, cut sugar step by step: sweet, kurang manis, then kosong.
Add lime for a fresher taste without sugar.
Go for teh O ais kosong on hot days. Still zero sugar.

swap.name: Teh O limau kosong
swap.why: Fresh lime taste, still almost zero calories.

faq.q: What does 'O' mean in teh O?
faq.a: 'O' means no milk. 'Kosong' means no sugar.

faq.q: Does teh O kosong have caffeine?
faq.a: Yes, from the tea. Usually less than coffee.

faq.q: Can I drink teh O kosong during puasa?
faq.a: It's a good choice for sahur or buka puasa since there's no sugar. Don't forget to drink plain water too.
